subject: Temporal GPU stow / provisional hold for Pegasus.ai POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Capacity Ops <capacity-ops@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short-term stow / provisional hold for Pegasus.ai POC (PEG-1873)

Team —

Heads-up on a late-stage POC that just moved to exec review. Pegasus.ai (Julia Park) asked for an interim capacity guarantee while procurement completes terms. Summary below: 

- Ask: provisional soft-hold (temporal stow) for 20 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west for a 6-week POC window (target start 2027-01-04).
- Workload: medium sequence-generation model 7B -> expected sustained token throughput ~30 tokens/sec peak per GPU, KV cache heavy on long contexts.
- Ramp: POC 20 GPUs day 1, potential production ramp to 60 GPUs within 90 days if POC passes.
- Commitment: customer is willing to sign a 3-month reserved-capacity option if we can guarantee initial hold and pricing guardrail. Deal: PEG-1873 (HubSpot link below).

Can Capacity Ops validate availability for that window and advise whether we can place a provisional stow on the fleet (soft hold that blocks new sales but is cancelable with 7 days notice)? What constraints or blackout windows should we flag? Also attach the customer request doc for context.

Attachments: pegasus_capacity_request.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/PEG-1873

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0136
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Capacity Ops <capacity-ops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term stow / provisional hold for Pegasus.ai POC (PEG-1873)

Soojin —

Thanks for the summary. Quick read on our side: we can provisionally earmark capacity but there are a few caveats. Current notes after an initial inventory sweep: 

- Us-west pool has 48 A100-equivalent GPUs available across mixed clusters between 2026-12-20 and 2027-02-15. However 12 of those are tentatively committed to an internal ramp (Team: Orion) starting 2027-01-10 — that commitment is soft.
- We can soft-hold up to 18 GPUs today without impacting existing firm commitments; holding 20+ requires approval from product operations (we'll need to re-evaluate cluster placement and preemptible scheduling).
- If Pegasus requires strict non-preemptible guarantees for the POC, cost and lead time increase materially.

Action items I need from you to lock something down: 
1) Confirm whether their POC can accept preemptible-backed instances for the first 2 weeks (we can convert to non-preemptible for the guaranteed window).
2) Provide a short model footprint (GPU memory per replica, KV cache size, expected max batch size).
3) Confirm the hard start/end dates and whether they need a time-of-day SLA (24/7 vs business hours).

I attached a current fleet snapshot to help. If we get the answers by EOD Monday I can propose a provisional 18-GPU soft-hold with a staged escalation path to 40 GPUs by week 6.

Attachment: fleet_snapshot_20261119.csv

- Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head, Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia@pegasus.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term stow / provisional hold for Pegasus.ai POC (PEG-1873)

Marcus —

Thanks, that helps. Answers inline: 

1) Preemptible acceptance: Pegasus prefers non-preemptible for the POC for consistency, but they said they "could accept" up to 30% preemptible if the overall start date is guaranteed. Julia (cc'd) — can you confirm?
2) Model footprint: 7B fp16 ~15GB GPU memory per replica; KV cache adds another ~3GB per active context; recommend 2 replicas per GPU for throughput; expect batch sizes of 1-4. (Attaching the customer's request doc and SOW v2 for reference).
3) Dates: Target POC start 2027-01-04; 6-week window; they prefer 24/7 for the first 2 weeks of POC, then business-hours only.

We are open to a staged approach: soft-hold 18 GPUs non-preemptible for the start date, convert another 22 to non-preemptible by week 6 if all good. Customer is willing to put down a non-refundable commitment deposit to secure day-1 capacity — happy to connect them to finance & legal.

Next step: Marcus/Karthik, if you can issue a provisional hold note and a short mutual action plan (MAP) indicating what we need to sign and by when, I will push procurement and circles on the customer side.

Links: DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/eg/documents/ABC-PEG-1873
Attachments: pegasus_sow_v2.pdf, pegasus_capacity_request.docx

Thanks —
Soojin
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Capacity Ops <capacity-ops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term stow / provisional hold for Pegasus.ai POC (PEG-1873)

Appreciate the detail. We can approve a provisional soft-stow with the following conditions: 

- Soft-hold: 18 non-preemptible GPUs allocated in us-west for 2027-01-04 through 2027-02-14. Soft-hold means we will not sell those GPUs to new customers but retain the ability to reallocate with 7 days notice if a higher-priority emergency arises.
- Escalation path: if Pegasus signs a reserved-capacity contract by 2026-12-15 we will convert the hold to a firm allocation and commit to a 30-day notice window for any reallocation.
- Ops checks: Logan to run a final cluster placement and thermal/maintenance blackout review by 2026-12-08. Marcus to confirm the internal Orion commitment status by 2026-11-24.
- Commercials: require a $25k deposit (applied to the first invoice) to activate the provisional hold; legal to review SOW change for non-preemptible language.

Logan — please confirm placement feasibility. Marcus — update on the Orion tentative commitment ASAP. Soojin — please loop in Finance/Legal and the customer (Julia) to get the deposit and signatures.

If everyone is aligned I will issue a provisional hold ticket and tag it to PEG-1873 in the capacity ledger.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
